transport.notice: PASS means coherent recorded command acceptance and frame/state evidence only; it does not prove physical actuator timing, driving quality, visual quality or dataset admission.

snapshot_kinematics.interpretation: Uses observed full actor XYZ/pitch/roll/yaw and world vectors, not the earlier zero-pitch center proxy. Formula agreement does not prove the declared rear-axle offset matches physical wheel geometry. Interval averages and endpoint velocities are different observables; their difference is not an error verdict or proof of actuator delay. No label or acceleration convention is changed.

full_raw_future_all_original_phases.interpretation: Necessary discrete XY/speed bounds, not a sufficient feasibility proof; yaw is a proxy. Overlapping horizon windows are not independent events. Original warmup anchors remain included, tail anchors remain context-only; unavailable futures are not extrapolated.

limitations: Read-only necessary-condition checks, not Common10 admission, learned driving, or function approval.
All warmup/driving future failures remain in the full-raw report; fixed selected membership is not a repaired old episode.
Catalog goal and stopping were not this moving task. Native tail is retained, not stopping-function evidence.
